channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Bolsonaristas comemoram convocação de Neymar; Lula silencia sobre seleção
item.description: Bolsonarist lawmakers celebrated Neymar Jr.'s call-up to the Brazilian national team, using the event on social media for political purposes. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, posted a photo beside the footballer holding a framed print of Neymar's footprints. President Lula remained silent on the selection.

item.title: Senado não pode votar Messias neste ano, e reenvio seria gesto político de Lula
item.description: The Senate cannot vote again on Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF in 2026 due to a 2010 rule prohibiting re-examination of a rejected nomination in the same legislative session. If Lula resubmits the name, the vote would only occur in 2027, unless Senate President Davi Alcolumbre changes the rules — seen as unlikely. Resubmitting would be a political gesture by Lula to support his ally, despite the rejection being tied to the 'BolsoMaster' scandal.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Flávio Bolsonaro insiste em associar caso Master a Lula | CNN 360º
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro insists on linking the Master case to Lula, attempting to tie the former president to corruption schemes involving public contracts. The accusation emerges amid investigations into alleged favoritism in public bidding, though no concrete evidence directly ties Lula to the case. The strategy aims to damage Lula's image in the 2026 elections by invoking narratives of morality and fiscal responsibility.

item.title: Com Neymar, elenco convocado para Copa vale R$ 5,32 bi
item.description: The Brazilian squad called up for the 2026 World Cup has a market value of R$ 5.32 billion (€909.7 million), according to Transfermarkt. Neymar returns after 31 months out due to a serious knee injury, having recently felt calf pain in a Santos match. The most valuable players are Vinícius Júnior (€150m), Raphinha (€80m), and Gabriel Magalhães (€75m).

item.title: Endrick é convocado para jogar na Copa de 2026 pela Seleção Brasileira
item.description: Endrick, an 18-year-old Brazilian forward, has been called up for the first time to the Brazil national team for the 2026 World Cup. He was on loan at Lyon but will return to Real Madrid ahead of the official announcement by the CBF on Monday (May 18). Endrick has progressed through Brazil’s youth teams (U-17, U-20, U-23) and received his first senior call-up in 2023.

item.title: O grande desafio de Lula na área que mais preocupa o eleitor
item.description: The Lula government launched the Brazil Against Organized Crime program with R$11 billion in investments to strengthen public security, initially focusing on the Amazon and border regions. However, experts doubt the initiative will yield electoral benefits before the 2026 elections, as implementation takes time and fear of violence remains a decisive factor for voters.

item.title: Bancada do PL protocola convite para PF explicar troca de delegado no inquérito das fraudes no INSS
item.description: The leader of the PL caucus in the Chamber, Sóstenes Cavalcante, filed a request inviting the Federal Police director-general, Andrei Rodrigues, to explain the replacement of the delegate in the INSS fraud investigation, which targets President Lula’s son and businessman Antônio Camilo Antunes. The opposition alleges government interference in PF autonomy, claiming the change occurred at a critical moment, right after a bank secrecy waiver request for Fábio Luís Lula da Silva. STF Minister André Mendonça also sought explanations, stating he was not informed prior to the change.

item.title: Damares aciona TCU por prejuízo de R$ 260 mi com vacinas vencidas
item.description: Senator Damares Alves has submitted an official request to the TCU for full access to an audit concerning the waste of over R$260 million in expired Coronavac vaccines purchased in 2023 under the Lula administration. The audit attributes the loss to delays in procurement by the Health Ministry, which resulted in 8 million of 10 million doses expiring and being incinerated. The government claims it inherited a state of complete abandonment of vaccine stocks from the Bolsonaro administration.

item.title: Carlo Ancelotti convoca a Seleção Brasileira para a Copa do Mundo. Siga ao vivo no YouTube
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti announced Brazil's 26-player squad for the 2026 World Cup at a special event at the Museu do Amanhã in Rio de Janeiro. The team is placed in Group C and will open its campaign against Morocco on June 13 at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. Attention is focused on whether Neymar, not called up since 2023, will make the list, while Danilo and Vinícius Júnior have already been confirmed by the coach.

item.title: Lula quer explorar petróleo na Margem Equatorial contra domínio de Trump
item.description: President Lula announced that Brazil will explore oil in the Equatorial Margin to prevent Donald Trump from claiming the region as his own, stating the exploration will be conducted with the utmost responsibility and profits used to subsidize fuels and secure the nation's future. He also blamed Trump for the Iran war and explained that the government is using Petrobras' extra profits from rising oil prices due to the conflict to subsidize gasoline and diesel, shielding Brazilian consumers from price hikes.

item.title: Crusoé: Joaquim Barbosa vai salvar a República?
item.description: Former STF Justice Joaquim Barbosa has been mentioned as a potential presidential candidate for 2026, though official polling with his name has not yet been released. A 2012 Ipespe survey, conducted while he was still a minister, showed 26% spontaneous support, indicating potential for an electoral surprise. The article speculates whether he could 'save the Republic,' reflecting hopes for political renewal.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja regras aprovadas pelo TSE para uso de IA
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has approved rules for the use of artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections, requiring AI-generated content to be labeled and prohibiting platforms like ChatGPT and Gemini from recommending or ranking candidates. The circulation of such content is banned in the 72 hours before and 24 hours after voting. Additionally, the court established that judges may invert the burden of proof in cases of AI-driven disinformation, shifting the responsibility to prove authenticity to the content creator.

item.title: Chapa Tereza-Michelle representa união agro-cristã do Brasil do século 21
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faces backlash after leaked conversations with Daniel Vorcaro, prompting center-right sectors to consider an alternative ticket led by Michelle Bolsonaro as presidential candidate and Tereza Cristina as running mate to capture evangelical voters still leaning toward Lula. The proposed ticket symbolizes the union of agribusiness and evangelicalism — the material and symbolic foundations of 21st-century Bolsonarism — and would be the first presidential slate with organic social cohesion in this configuration.

item.title: A aventura Joaquim Barbosa
item.description: Joaquim Barbosa, former rapporteur of the mensalão case at the STF and former president of the court, is once again mentioned as a presidential alternative for the 2026 elections, despite having left the STF in 2014. His figure is portrayed as a symbol of hope for confronting the country's problems, although his viability as a candidate is considered unfeasible.

item.title: Neymar, técnico estrangeiro, jejum: por que esta pode ser a convocação mais marcante da seleção desde 2002
item.description: The Brazil national team's 2026 World Cup squad selection may be the most significant since 2002, particularly due to the debate over Neymar's inclusion, weighing his fitness, experience, and tactical influence. It also marks the first time Brazil will be coached by a foreigner, Carlo Ancelotti, whose appointment—though controversial—represents a historic shift after two consecutive quarterfinal exits under Tite. The parallels to Romário’s 2002 call-up underscore the symbolic weight of this moment.

item.title: Os próximos passos de Messias à frente da AGU
item.description: Despite the rejection of his nomination to the STF by the Senate, Jorge Messias is expected to remain as head of the AGU, according to Radar reports. The government plans to strengthen his position through a symbolic reappointment and implement internal changes within the AGU, particularly against those who did not support his STF bid. The move reflects the government’s strategy to retain him in office despite the parliamentary setback.

item.title: Dino relata xingamento e hostilidade de funcionária de companhia aérea
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino reported being subjected to verbal abuse and hostility by an airline employee at an airport. He shared the incident on social media and urged business leaders to promote civic education, emphasizing that political tensions tend to rise during election years.

item.title: Lula volta a defender exploração na Margem Equatorial: 'Daqui a pouco, o Trump vem e acha que é dele'
item.description: Lula criticized the 2019 sale of BR Distribuidora, arguing that state control would ease distribution of cooking gas without transportation costs. He also advocated for exploring the Equatorial Margin basin, warning that without Brazilian action, foreign powers — particularly the U.S. under Trump — might claim the region, citing Trump’s past assertions over Canada, Greenland, the Gulf of Mexico, and the Panama Canal.

item.title: Dino relata ameaça de atendente de companhia aérea que disse ter vontade de matá-lo por atuação no STF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino reported that an airline employee expressed a desire to kill him due to his role in the court, calling it a contamination by hatred. He urged companies to promote civic education campaigns for employees to ensure peaceful coexistence during the election year and prevent risks to airport and flight security.

item.title: Múcio vai à Argentina conversar sobre venda de armas pro governo Milei
item.description: Defense Minister José Múcio will travel to Argentina next Monday to discuss arms sales to the government of Javier Milei. The initiative came from Brazil and was well received by Argentine authorities, signaling a channel of dialogue despite political differences between Lula and Milei.

item.title: O que mostram as pesquisas sobre a convocação de Neymar para a Copa
item.description: Coach Carlo Ancelotti will announce on Monday the squad for the 2026 World Cup, with major anticipation surrounding Neymar, who was omitted from previous call-ups. Google searches related to a possible Neymar call-up have surged over 350% in recent days, reflecting intense Brazilian fan interest. The official confirmation will be released at 5 p.m.

item.title: Lula cita possível interesse de Trump e defende exploração da Margem Equatorial pela Petrobras: 'Nós vamos ocupar'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated for Petrobras to explore oil in the Equatorial Margin during an event in São Paulo, stating Brazil 'will occupy' the region. He mentioned potential interest from Donald Trump in the initiative, suggesting it could attract international partnerships. Lula emphasized the strategic importance of the area for national energy sovereignty.

item.title: Petrobras destina R$ 37 bi para projetos em São Paulo até 2030
item.description: Petrobras announced R$ 37 billion in investments in São Paulo until 2030, focusing on refining, bio-refining, exploration and production, decarbonization, and sustainable energy generation. The plan includes expansion of the Replan refinery (Paulínia), construction of SAF and renewable diesel units, new wells in the Santos Basin, and logistical improvements, generating approximately 38,000 direct and indirect jobs.

item.title: Decisão do TCU sobre Transnordestina é 'equivocada', diz Humberto Costa
item.description: Senator Humberto Costa (PT-PE) criticized the TCU's decision to suspend new financial commitments for the Salgueiro-Suape stretch of the Transnordestina Railway, arguing it threatens jobs and the development of Pernambuco and the Northeast, especially the Semiárido region. He emphasized the project's strategic importance for regional integration and the transport of agricultural and industrial production, noting its resumption followed a decision by President Lula's government. Humberto blamed former President Jair Bolsonaro and then-Minister of Infrastructure Tarcísio de Freitas for excluding Pernambuco from the original project.

item.title: Hostilizado no aeroporto, Dino pede que empresas ensinem educação cívica a funcionários
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino reported being subjected to hostility by an airline employee, who allegedly said she would rather 'kill' than insult him after seeing his name on a boarding pass. He emphasized the incident is not merely personal but collective, warning that such hatred could spread and endanger airport and flight safety, as well as other sectors, especially amid heightened tensions in the 2026 election year. Dino urged companies, particularly those serving the public, to implement internal civic education campaigns to promote peaceful coexistence.

item.title: Prefeita petista é cassada em MG em disputa que envolve divórcio
item.description: The mayor of Francisco Sá (MG), Alini Bicalho (PT), was removed from office by judicial decision applying STF’s Binding Precedent 18, which holds that divorce during a mandate does not remove the ineligibility of a spouse of an executive official, despite her claim that the separation occurred before 2020 and that she had previously won a related case. The ruling, requested by Minister Nunes Marques, follows a motion by opposition coalitions arguing her ineligibility due to her marital link to former mayor Mario Osvaldo (Avante).

item.title: Mercado acompanha o caso Flávio Bolsonaro e de olho nas próximas pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: Financial markets are closely monitoring the Federal Police investigation into Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, as the weakening of his image as the main opposition figure for the 2026 elections raises concerns that President Lulu is gaining political ground, reducing expectations for fiscally conservative reforms. Investors fear political instability could heighten volatility in stocks and exchange rates, though they acknowledge the opposition may have greater intent to address public spending than the current government, despite structural constraints.

item.title: Lula anuncia investimento bilionário da Petrobras para ampliar produção de combustíveis no país
item.description: President Lula announces a 37 billion reais investment by Petrobras in São Paulo through 2030 to expand fuel production and refining, including modernization of the Replan refinery in Paulínia. The goal is to reduce import dependence and strengthen the state-owned company’s position in the state, with part of the funds allocated to decarbonization and sustainable energy generation.

item.title: PL tenta surfar na escalação de Ancelotti para a Copa
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) released two videos featuring its pre-candidates wearing the Brazilian national team jersey, attempting to ride the wave of anticipation surrounding Carlo Ancelotti's World Cup squad selection. The official list of 26 players will be announced on Monday, the 18th, at 5 p.m. The move aims to align the party's electoral campaign with the national team's popularity.

item.title: O apelido de Zema no Novo após chamar de 'imperdoável' áudio de Flávio a Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema earned an internal nickname within the Novo party after releasing a video in which he labeled as 'imperdoável' an audio of Flávio Bolsonaro negotiating with Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro. The incident sparked discussion among party members, who viewed the remark as a strong criticism of efforts to use private funds for politically favorable content about the former president. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Ao vivo: comissão da escala 6 X 1 ouve entidades empresariais
item.description: The special committee in the Chamber is discussing the end of the 6x1 work scale with business entities, aiming to unify two PECs that reduce the weekly workweek to 36 hours. Rapporteur Deputy Leo Prates has two more days to finalize the report before Wednesday's vote, while the government seeks immediate implementation and businesses request time to avoid mass layoffs.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula anuncia investimentos da Petrobras em SP
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announces, this Monday (May 18, 2026), at 2:00 p.m., at the Replan (Paulínia Refinery) in Paulínia (SP), Petrobras' investment of R$ 37 billion in São Paulo through 2030. The funds will support refining, bio-refining, logistics, exploration and production, decarbonization, and sustainable energy, with R$ 6 billion allocated specifically to Replan, the state-owned company's largest refinery.

item.title: Lindbergh: Se Lula indicar de novo Messias, Senado terá de votar
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) defended that President Lula may nominate again the Attorney General of the Union, Jorge Messias, for the STF in 2026. He stated that if the nomination is confirmed, the Senate would only have to conduct hearings and vote on the name.

item.title: PL convoca reunião com Flávio Bolsonaro e bancadas do Senado e da Câmara após crise com Master
item.description: The PL party convened a meeting with Flávio Bolsonaro and Senate and Chamber caucuses to discuss political strategy following a crisis over messages in which he sought $24 million in funding from Banco Master for a film about Jair Bolsonaro. This is the first large-scale parliamentary meeting since the Intercept Brasil exposé, which revealed contradictions in Flávio’s statements and those of allies like Deputy Mario Frias. The scandal has drawn criticism even from allies, who cite poor communication and premature remarks as damaging to the opposition’s coherence.

item.title: Aliados de Lula veem brecha em regra do Senado para insistir na indicação de Messias
item.description: Lula's allies believe the Senate rule blocking a new vote on Jorge Messias' STF nomination can be flexibilized, as it is an infralegal norm dependent only on Senate President Davi Alcolumbre's will. Despite the historic rejection in April, Lula still holds Messias in high regard, viewing him as a political victim, and would only renominate him if assured of victory — a condition tied to meeting parliamentary demands, such as releasing budget amendments.

item.title: Terras raras: Lula diz esperar que Trump ‘pare de brigar’ com Xi e se associe ao Brasil
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil will not veto or favor any country in rare earth exploration discussions, but conditioned partnerships on respect for national sovereignty. He expressed hope that Donald Trump would stop fighting with Xi Jinping and ally with Brazil to explore these critical minerals, emphasizing that 'critical minerals are ours, rare earths are ours'.

item.title: PL tenta ampliar desgaste de Lula após caso Vorcaro atingir Flávio
item.description: The leader of the PL in the Chamber, Sóstenes Cavalcante, published criticisms of President Lula following the leak of messages involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, attempting to exploit the case to generate political damage against the petista. The PL’s strategy seeks to leverage the connection between Lula and Vorcaro, CEO of Banco Master, to attack the government’s image, even though the initial focus was on Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Forçar indicação de Messias é “desrespeito ao Parlamento”, diz Rosângela Moro
item.description: Federal Deputy Rosângela Moro (PL-SP) criticized the potential new nomination of Attorney General Jorge Messias to the STF in 2026, calling it a disrespect to Parliament. She noted that an internal Senate rule prohibits considering, in the same legislative session, the nomination of an authority already rejected by the House.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira planeja demonstração de força com ‘megajantar’ a prefeitos em Brasília
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), under investigation by the Federal Police for allegedly receiving a monthly stipend of R$ 300,000 from Banco Master’s owner, is organizing a dinner with Piaui mayors in Brasília as a show of electoral strength. Around 70% of the state’s 224 mayors (156 officials) have confirmed attendance, coinciding with the Mayors’ March in the capital. The senator, running for re-election in 2026, emphasized that he allocates 100% of his parliamentary amendments to Piaui municipalities and called the upcoming election 'the most important of his life'.

item.title: Thiago Silva: Carlo Ancelotti afirmou que tem planos para o jogador na Copa
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti confirmed that Thiago Silva is in Brazil's plans for the 2026 World Cup, praising his strong physical condition and recent Portuguese league title. He also stated that Neymar's inclusion will depend solely on his fitness, and highlighted the leadership of Alisson Becker, Casemiro, Marquinhos, and Raphinha within the squad.

item.title: Lula inaugura 4 novas linhas de luz síncrotron do acelerador de partículas Sirius
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva inaugurated on Monday morning, April 18, four new synchrotron light lines of the Sirius particle accelerator at the CNPEM in Campinas, São Paulo. Sirius is one of the world’s most advanced accelerators, used for research in materials, energy, health, and the environment. The expansion underscores the federal government’s commitment to science and technology investment.

item.title: Ricardo Nunes endossa André do Prado para disputa ao Senado de SP
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) publicly endorsed André do Prado (PL-SP) as a pre-candidate for the 2026 Senate race during the opening of the Apas Show. The endorsement reflects right-wing mobilization in São Paulo, though it has sparked division among Bolsonaro supporters, with Ricardo Salles (Novo) opposing the choice and clashing with Eduardo Bolsonaro, who backs Prado’s candidacy.

item.title: Como o PT articula uma nova arma contra Flávio Bolsonaro na eleição de 2026
item.description: The PT launched a digital offensive against Flávio Bolsonaro, linking him to the Banco Master scandal through leaked audios with banker Daniel Vorcaro. The strategy, already underway on social media and prepared since the party’s national congress, uses the term 'Bolsomaster' to undermine the senator as Lula’s main rival in a technically tied presidential race.

item.title: Regimento do Senado proíbe que indicação de Messias seja votada de novo neste ano
item.description: The Senate's internal rules prohibit reconsidering a rejected appointment within the same year, posing a potential obstacle to President Lula's plan to resend Jorge Messias's nomination to the STF before the 2026 elections. The government faces resistance after Messias was historically rejected by a 42-34 vote in April, which shattered Lula's alliance with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Despite uncertainty, Lula has told allies he intends to resend the nomination before the elections, contingent on Senate negotiations.

item.title: Após crise dos áudios, Zema coloca em prática uma estratégia arriscada, mas com limites
item.description: Romeu Zema hardened his rhetoric against Flávio Bolsonaro following the audio scandal involving Daniel Vorcaro, but avoided a formal political break with bolsonarism, maintaining his willingness to support it in a potential runoff against Lula. His strategy aims to cultivate an image of moral independence without alienating his conservative base, leveraging his strong social media presence to engage with outrage-driven audiences. Unlike Caiado, who takes a more diplomatic approach, Zema combines confrontation with institutions like the STF with a more aggressive, algorithm-friendly communication style.

item.title: Lula inaugura 4 novas linhas do Sirius voltadas a pesquisas científicas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva inaugurated four new beamlines of the Sirius particle accelerator at Cnpem in Campinas (SP), with an investment of R$800 million, completing the second phase of the project funded by the Novo PAC. The Tatu, Sapucaia, Quati, and Sapê beamlines will enable advanced research in health, energy, nanotechnology, critical minerals, and new materials, strengthening Brazil’s scientific and innovation capacity.

item.title: Câmara deve votar nesta semana projetos de Lula contra alta dos combustíveis
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies is set to vote this week on two government proposals by Lula to curb fuel price increases. One defines abusive price hikes as a specific crime against consumer relations, punishable by two to five years in detention, with increased penalties during public calamities or market crises. The other links extraordinary federal revenue from oil exports to measures stabilizing domestic fuel prices, including subsidies and tax exemptions on diesel, cooking gas, biodiesel, and aviation kerosene.

item.title: Zema ironiza Gilmar Mendes e pede convocação de Neymar
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for presidency from Novo, mocked Minister Gilmar Mendes by asking him to 'call up Neymar' for the World Cup, referencing an incorrect substitution. The post is part of Zema's satirical series 'Os Intocáveis', where Gilmar is portrayed as a puppet. Zema has been denounced by the Prosecutor General for defamation, with the case referred to the STJ.

item.title: Escândalo de áudios abala Flávio, mas analistas veem uma boa notícia para a direita em 2026
item.description: The leak of audios involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, linked to the Banco Master scandal, has caused damage to his 2026 presidential campaign, though analysts say it does not yet rule out a runoff against Lula. They note the episode marks the beginning of the 'burden' of candidacy for Flávio, who until now benefited from the 'bonus' of the Bolsonaro surname, but now faces public scrutiny over personal and political vulnerabilities. Despite the impact, experts believe his candidacy is not dead and it is too early to predict definitive electoral consequences.

item.title: Flávio reúne bancada após crise sobre filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) convened a meeting with allied federal deputies from the Liberal Party to align strategies for his 2026 presidential pre-campaign and quell internal tensions sparked by the leak of an audio in which he requests funds to finance the film 'Dark Horse', inspired by his father Jair Bolsonaro's political trajectory. The move aims to strengthen party unity amid criticism over the use of party resources for projects tied to the Bolsonaro family.
